jobs.title: Technical Solution Engineer - AI Data Center (AIDC)
jobs.description:
About Us

Contemporary Amperex Technology (USA), Inc. (CATU) is a U.S. subsidiary of Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL), a global leader in the research, development and manufacturing of advanced electric vehicle and energy storage batteries. Established in Michigan in 2017, CATU has played a critical role in advancing electric mobility and energy resilience in the U.S.

Our Vision

To become a globally leading innovative technology corporation, contribute meaningfully to sustainable energy solutions, and provide a platform that supports both the professional and personal growth of our employees.

Job Overview

AIDC Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A AIDC engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, AIDC engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences.

Location:

San Jose, CA / Seattle, WA only. We support relocation!

Key Responsibilities:

Collect and analyze technical requirements for overseas data center projects.
Communicate with customers and provide data center solutions based on their requirements; prepare bidding and proposal documents.
Identify risks and resolve system-level issues throughout the product development process.
Track testing, pilot production, and certification results; prepare R&D documentation such as product specifications and patents.
Draft technical agreements.
Be able to undertake long-term business travel or on-site assignments to provide localized customer support.

Preferred Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree or above; preferred majors include Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Automation, or related fields.
Experience in data center power systems design, including HVDC, PDU (Panama power distribution), supercapacitors, UPS, BBU, power modules, or related areas.
At least 3 years of technical experience in customer-facing roles within the data center industry is preferred.
Experience with products or projects that have been successfully mass-produced or delivered is preferred.
Strong communication, organization, coordination, and comprehension skills.
Highly proactive, with solid logical thinking and strong teamwork abilities.
Proficient in spoken and written English.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

Regular, predictable on-site attendance is an essential function of this role.
Ability to move throughout offices, manufacturing facilities, and construction areas, including walking, standing, bending, kneeling, and climbing stairs or ladders.
Ability to lift and carry materials weighing up to 25–50 pounds, with occasional heavier lifting as required, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Ability to work in varied environments, including offices, industrial, and construction settings.
Willingness to travel to other job sites as business needs require.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, in accordance with applicable law.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
401(k) retirement plan with company match.
Paid time off and company holidays.
Professional development and growth opportunities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

CATU is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employment Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. CATU reserves the right to modify, revise, or add job responsibilities as business needs evolve. Employment with CATU is at-will, meaning either the employee or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

Export Control & Data Security Compliance

This position may involve access to sensitive systems or information subject to U.S. export control and data security regulations. Employment is contingent upon the employee’s ability to comply with applicable laws and company policies related to data protection and controlled information access.

jobs.title: Sr. GenAI Strategist - Startups, Generative AI Innovation Center
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced and motivated senior business-oriented technologist who possesses a unique balance of startup ecosystem knowledge, effective interpersonal skills, and technological depth in the following areas: analytics/big data, machine learning, and generative artificial intelligence. This senior role will focus on supporting startup customers looking to accelerate their growth, achieve product-market fit, or enhance their business outcomes through the use of advanced and emerging generative AI technologies.

You will partner with startup founders, CTOs, venture capital firms, AWS Startup Sales, AWS service teams, AWS industry teams, and AWS Professional Services delivery teams to craft startup-specific programs that address the unique constraints and opportunities of high-growth companies — speed to market, capital efficiency, and scalable architecture from day one. You will extend successful patterns across the startup portfolio and into adjacent segments.

You will leverage and refine a programmatic approach to help startup customers drive their business metrics across a set of startup-specific needs including inference cost optimization, rapid prototyping, go-to-market acceleration, and investor-ready AI roadmaps. As a trusted senior startup advocate, the Senior GenAI Startup Strategist will assess and deliver best practices around program delivery, lean project approaches, and business measurement tailored to the pace and resource profile of startups. The ability to connect business value to a scalable, repeatable, extensible approach — while respecting the speed and agility startups demand — is critical to this senior role.

Key job responsibilities

Bring alignment between startup founders, technical leaders, and business stakeholders; help them explore the art of the possible with generative AI and machine learning, and develop a roadmap to deliver business value with startup-appropriate speed and capital efficiency
Serve as a senior thought leader within the team, mentoring junior strategists and shaping the overall startup engagement methodology
Discuss complex AI/ML business concepts with startup executives, VCs, and technical founders across stages from seed to growth
Engage with various AWS teams, including applied scientists, solutions architects, business development, marketing, startup specialists, partners, and regional organizations
Drive strategic engagements with high-potential startups from ideation, through vision building and scoping, all the way to closure and into delivery
Identify repeatable generative AI patterns across the startup portfolio and codify them into scalable programs and frameworks
Conduct workshop sessions with startup customers to identify opportunities for delivering business value through generative AI or machine learning, with an emphasis on rapid time-to-value
Build relationships with the VC and accelerator ecosystem to source and support AI-native startups on AWS

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
6+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
Experience working in or supporting sales, with preference for startup or high-growth company contexts
Experience launching technical programs, projects, or related work that include the following: big data, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments
Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
Direct experience working at, advising, or investing in startups — particularly AI-native or ML-first companies

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Design and ship agents that retrieve information, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks across our business systems
Connect workflows across tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Asana, Shopify, and Klaviyo through APIs, webhooks, and MCP integrations
Make long-running workflows dependable with persistent state, retries, duplicate prevention, clear approvals, and recoverable failures

jobs.description:
About The Job

Blockit is hiring for this role in San Francisco, and Harper, an AI career agent, is on your side of the table. Skip the application form: just talk to Harper, and in a few minutes it learns your background, then puts the strongest profiles directly in front of Blockit's founders. 👉 Start with Harper

Job Title

Software Engineer, AI Agents at Blockit, San Francisco

Level

2+ years shipping and owning production software. Strong backend engineer; LLMs in production is a plus, not a requirement.

Salary

Competitive salary + equity at a Sequoia-backed company.

Location

San Francisco, CA. On-site 4 days per week. Full-time.

Company Description

Blockit is a Sequoia-backed AI scheduling agent: CC it on any email or Slack thread and it negotiates the times, handles the time zones, and sends the invite. Customers include teams at Andreessen Horowitz, Index Ventures, Accel, Thrive Capital, Ramp, Vanta, Clay, and Granola. Founded by a former Sequoia partner and covered by TechCrunch and Sequoia in January 2026. While every LLM application to date has been a one-on-one conversation, Blockit is one of the first multiplayer, stateful AI agents: it coordinates between multiple people, keeps context across conversations, and takes real actions in the world.

The Role

You own the intelligence at the core of Blockit: the scheduling agents that autonomously coordinate meetings across people, time zones, and constraints. Design and iterate on agent architectures, write and refine prompts, build evaluation frameworks, and ship new capabilities as models improve, across the orchestrator agents that manage conversation flow and the specialized sub-agents. These are real-world AI agents used in production by thousands of people.

What You'll Do

Write and refine prompts across the agent system: orchestrators, sub-agents, and tools
Build and maintain evals to measure agent quality and catch regressions
Debug agent failures: figure out why it misunderstood a request or made a bad call
Implement new agent capabilities as user needs expand
Experiment with new architectures and techniques as models improve
Instrument and analyze agent behavior to find patterns and failure modes

Who You Are

2+ years of experience shipping and owning production software
Strong backend engineering skills, with the ability to work across the stack when needed
Experience working with LLMs in production systems, or a demonstrated ability to learn quickly in this space
Deep curiosity about agent architectures and how the industry is evolving beyond simple prompt-based systems
Clear, structured communicator who can explain what's working, what isn't, and why

Why Join

Own the core of a production AI agent that already schedules for teams at a16z, Index, Ramp, and Vanta
Tiny, senior team backed by Sequoia; every customer so far came inbound
Work in person in San Francisco with people who ship daily

How This Works

Harper is an AI career agent on your side, free for candidates and paid by companies.
Talk to Harper for 5 minutes. No resume form.
If you're a fit, your profile goes straight to Blockit's hiring team, and only after you approve.
Not a fit? Harper keeps sending you roles you wouldn't find on your own.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
A high-growth AI-native startup is hiring an ML Engineer in San Francisco to take models from notebook to production and keep them performant, reliable and affordable at scale.

This role sits at the intersection of ML and engineering: strong Python, strong PyTorch, and the engineering maturity to turn models into real product surfaces. You’ll own training, serving, evaluation and the plumbing underneath.

Role: ML Engineer
Salary: $200,000 - $350,000 plus equity
Location: San Francisco, 5 days per week in office

What you’ll be doing:

Train, fine-tune and serve models in production using Python and PyTorch
Build and maintain the inference stack: model serving (vLLM, Triton, custom), batching, caching, cost control
Stand up training infrastructure using Ray, Modal, SageMaker or similar
Work with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) for retrieval-heavy workloads
Build evaluation pipelines so model quality is measurable rather than anecdotal
Partner with product and AI engineers to turn research or OSS models into shipped features
Own GPU utilisation, latency and inference cost as first-class concerns
Use AI tooling (Claude, Cursor and similar) across every part of your workflow

What you’ll need:

Strong Python and PyTorch experience with real production ML systems behind you
Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, modern training workflows and distributed training
Hands-on with model serving stacks (vLLM, TensorRT, Triton or equivalent) and GPU-level optimisation
Comfort with experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases) and reproducibility hygiene
Cloud experience (AWS, GCP or Azure) and modern infra tooling
Fluent in modern AI engineering tools and able to use them to raise output
Happy working 5 days a week in-person with a small, high-intensity team

Nice to have:

Experience fine-tuning or post-training LLMs (SFT, DPO, RLHF)
Low-latency inference work or custom CUDA kernels
Prior work securing or hardening ML systems in production

This role would suit an ML engineer who treats the inference bill, the latency graph and the eval harness as part of their job, not someone else’s.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Our client is an enterprise AI platform that helps large organizations move from AI ambition to AI agents running reliably in production. Their technology allows enterprises to design, deploy, and operate AI agents that connect to core business systems and carry out real operational work end-to-end, rather than remaining at the pilot or proof-of-concept stage. Backed by leading international investors and growing quickly, they work hand-in-hand with enterprise customers as those organizations transform into AI-driven businesses.

The Role
Our client is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to solve high-impact, real-world problems alongside enterprise customers, owning work from first principles through to production outcomes.

You will work directly and in person with customers to understand critical workflows, design AI-driven solutions, and deploy agents that operate reliably in production. You will own projects end-to-end — from problem definition and system design through to launch and iteration — and be accountable for real business impact.

This is a hands-on generalist role for engineers who enjoy navigating ambiguity, learning quickly, and working across systems while partnering with enterprises on their AI transformation.

Requirements
5+ years of experience in technical problem-solving roles
Experience leading or contributing to solution scoping, discovery workshops, or early-stage AI/technical strategy in collaboration with sales, product, or deployment teams
Strong fundamentals in software design and system design
Clear communication skills and a strong ownership mindset
High-agency mindset: you don't wait for perfect requirements and are comfortable creating clarity, proposing direction, and driving decisions
Experience working across systems, integrations, and data flows
Comfort working directly with customers and owning ambiguous problems
Curiosity and interest in building AI-powered systems that work in practice
Nice to Have
Experience in forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing roles
Exposure to AI agents, automation, or conversational systems
Experience operating and improving production systems
Experience working in a high-growth or early-stage startup environment
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

Responsibilities
Partner with customers to understand operational challenges and success criteria
Translate open-ended problems into clear technical designs and implementations
Build AI agents that integrate with customer systems and perform real tasks
Own deployments, including reliability, performance, and continuous improvement
Test with real data, measure outcomes, and iterate based on results

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Thesis, we believe everyone should have the opportunity to meet their potential. We build nootropic supplements and customer experiences that help people find the right support for their goals.

Across Thesis and Stasis, we're also changing how our company works. Our teams use AI to develop creative, research customers, build digital experiences, analyze performance, and reduce repetitive operational work. We're looking for an engineer who can turn those experiments into reliable systems that people use every day.

About The Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to build the agents, integrations, and internal tools that help a small team accomplish more. You'll work with Data, Engineering, Growth, Creative, and Operations to find valuable problems, prototype solutions, and own them through deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on applied AI. You'll build with existing models, connect them to our tools and knowledge, and make their outputs useful and trustworthy. You should be as comfortable debugging an API integration as designing an agent workflow, and care about whether your work saves time, improves decisions, or helps the business grow.

We already have AI-assisted workflows and a shared Claude skill and knowledge system. You'll build on that foundation, making successful workflows easier to reuse and bringing production engineering to the parts that need it. You won't be starting from a blank page, and you won't be limited to maintaining what's already there.

How You'll Make an Impact

Build agents that do useful work

Design and ship agents that retrieve information, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks across our business systems.
Connect workflows across tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Asana, Shopify, and Klaviyo through APIs, webhooks, and MCP integrations.
Make long-running workflows dependable with persistent state, retries, duplicate prevention, clear approvals, and recoverable failures.

Accelerate creative and growth workflows

Partner with Creative and Growth to improve the path from customer research and performance insights to briefs, scripts, creative variants, and testable landing pages.
Build workflows that combine brand knowledge, approved product claims, asset libraries, and creative performance data while keeping human review where it matters.
Help teams learn from prior experiments so each new brief or test benefits from what we've already discovered.

Make company knowledge and data more useful

Extend our shared skills, knowledge base, retrieval, and context-management systems so AI tools can find and use the right source material.
Partner with our data team to connect AI workflows to governed analytics in Metabase and Hex, backed by Snowflake, rather than inventing competing definitions of business metrics.
Use SQL and data validation to investigate issues, verify outputs, and make analytical workflows easier for non-technical teammates to use.

Turn prototypes into reliable products

Build evaluations using real business tasks. Test accuracy, task completion, tool behavior, failure recovery, latency, and cost before scaling a workflow.
Add monitoring, useful logs, version control, automated tests, and clear documentation. Own failures after launch and fix their causes.
Protect customer and company data, separate brand and account contexts, and preserve human approval for consequential actions.
Choose the simplest approach that works, including ordinary code or deterministic automation when an LLM adds no value.

Help the company use AI well

Work directly with teammates to understand their workflows, ship usable interfaces, and help them adopt what you build.
Create reusable skills and integrations rather than isolated prompts that only their author can operate.
Evaluate new models and tools through practical experiments, then explain what is worth adopting and why.
Measure outcomes such as time saved, adoption, output quality, and faster experiment cycles, not just the number of automations shipped.

We're Excited About Your

Experience shipping software that real users depend on, with ownership beyond the initial prototype.
Hands-on LLM application development using Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable APIs, including structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, and multi-step workflows.
Strong Python or TypeScript skills, sound software design, and comfort working with APIs, authentication, databases, and asynchronous jobs.
Practical understanding of RAG, context management, and MCP. You can explain the tradeoffs and show when a simpler approach is better.
Ability to build evaluations, diagnose unreliable behavior, and improve an AI system using evidence rather than prompt tweaking alone.
Working SQL proficiency and experience validating data against established reporting or warehouse models.
Product judgment and clear communication. You can turn an ambiguous request into a focused solution, explain technical tradeoffs, and work effectively with non-technical partners.
Curiosity, initiative, and follow-through. You experiment independently, learn quickly, and take responsibility for whether your work is useful.

Experience with Claude Code, Codex, shared agent skills, or agent orchestration platforms such as OpenClaw is a plus. So is experience with ecommerce, consumer subscriptions, creative production, multimodal generation, or analytics tools such as PostHog and Metabase. We don't expect you to have used every tool in our stack.

How You'll Work

You'll work on problems with visible business impact, from reducing manual reporting to making creative production and customer research more effective. You'll partner closely with the people doing the work, test with real inputs, and keep improving the system after it ships.

We value people who can move quickly without confusing a convincing demo with a dependable product. Bring strong engineering fundamentals, good judgment about where AI helps, and a willingness to get into the details.

In Your Application

Tell us about an AI system you built that people actually use. What problem did it solve, what did you personally build, how did you evaluate it, and what failed along the way? Share a demo, repository, or architecture walkthrough where possible. Please don't include confidential information from another employer.

A Few of Our Perks and Benefits

Competitive compensation and equity.
Health, dental, and vision plans.
HSA, FSA, and pre-tax commuter benefits.
401k to help you plan for the future.
Flexible PTO.
Unlimited Thesis nootropics.
A strong emphasis on personal development and promoting from within.
A dog-friendly office in Flatiron, near Union Square and Madison Square Park.

Our Values

Meet Your Potential:
Keep learning, seek honest feedback, and help others grow.

Own Outcomes:
Take responsibility for results, act with urgency, and follow through.

Lead with Science and Data:
Seek the truth through evidence and use it to make better decisions.

Create Exceptional Experiences:
Show up for teammates and customers with care, high standards, and a sense of belonging.

Pay Transparency

Our salary ranges reflect competitive compensation for our size and industry and are one part of a total rewards package that includes benefits and equity. The base salary hiring range for this position is $160,000–$200,000. Final compensation will be based on the candidate's location, skill level, and experience.

Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced and motivated senior business-oriented technologist who possesses a unique balance of startup ecosystem knowledge, effective interpersonal skills, and technological depth in the following areas: analytics/big data, machine learning, and generative artificial intelligence. This senior role will focus on supporting startup customers looking to accelerate their growth, achieve product-market fit, or enhance their business outcomes through the use of advanced and emerging generative AI technologies.

You will partner with startup founders, CTOs, venture capital firms, AWS Startup Sales, AWS service teams, AWS industry teams, and AWS Professional Services delivery teams to craft startup-specific programs that address the unique constraints and opportunities of high-growth companies — speed to market, capital efficiency, and scalable architecture from day one. You will extend successful patterns across the startup portfolio and into adjacent segments.

You will leverage and refine a programmatic approach to help startup customers drive their business metrics across a set of startup-specific needs including inference cost optimization, rapid prototyping, go-to-market acceleration, and investor-ready AI roadmaps. As a trusted senior startup advocate, the Senior GenAI Startup Strategist will assess and deliver best practices around program delivery, lean project approaches, and business measurement tailored to the pace and resource profile of startups. The ability to connect business value to a scalable, repeatable, extensible approach — while respecting the speed and agility startups demand — is critical to this senior role.

Key job responsibilities

Bring alignment between startup founders, technical leaders, and business stakeholders; help them explore the art of the possible with generative AI and machine learning, and develop a roadmap to deliver business value with startup-appropriate speed and capital efficiency
Serve as a senior thought leader within the team, mentoring junior strategists and shaping the overall startup engagement methodology
Discuss complex AI/ML business concepts with startup executives, VCs, and technical founders across stages from seed to growth
Engage with various AWS teams, including applied scientists, solutions architects, business development, marketing, startup specialists, partners, and regional organizations

Identify repeatable generative AI patterns across the startup portfolio and codify them into scalable programs and frameworks

Blockit is hiring for this role in San Francisco, and Harper, an AI career agent, is on your side of the table. 2+ years shipping and owning production software. Strong backend engineer; LLMs in production is a plus, not a requirement.

Salary

Competitive salary + equity at a Sequoia-backed company.

Location

San Francisco, CA. On-site 4 days per week. Full-time.

Company Description

Blockit is a Sequoia-backed AI scheduling agent: CC it on any email or Slack thread and it negotiates the times, handles the time zones, and sends the invite. Customers include teams at Andreessen Horowitz, Index Ventures, Accel, Thrive Capital, Ramp, Vanta, Clay, and Granola. Founded by a former Sequoia partner and covered by TechCrunch and Sequoia in January 2026. While every LLM application to date has been a one-on-one conversation, Blockit is one of the first multiplayer, stateful AI agents: it coordinates between multiple people, keeps context across conversations, and takes real actions in the world.

The Role

You own the intelligence at the core of Blockit: the scheduling agents that autonomously coordinate meetings across people, time zones, and constraints. Design and iterate on agent architectures, write and refine prompts, build evaluation frameworks, and ship new capabilities as models improve, across the orchestrator agents that manage conversation flow and the specialized sub-agents. These are real-world AI agents used in production by thousands of people.

What You'll Do

Write and refine prompts across the agent system: orchestrators, sub-agents, and tools
Build and maintain evals to measure agent quality and catch regressions
Debug agent failures: figure out why it misunderstood a request or made a bad call
Implement new agent capabilities as user needs expand
Experiment with new architectures and techniques as models improve
Instrument and analyze agent behavior to find patterns and failure modes

Who You Are

2+ years of experience shipping and owning production software
Strong backend engineering skills, with the ability to work across the stack when needed
Experience working with LLMs in production systems, or a demonstrated ability to learn quickly in this space
Deep curiosity about agent architectures and how the industry is evolving beyond simple prompt-based systems

Own the core of a production AI agent that already schedules for teams at a16z, Index, Ramp, and Vanta
Tiny, senior team backed by Sequoia; every customer so far came inbound
Work in person in San Francisco with people who ship daily

Harper is an AI career agent on your side, free for candidates and paid by companies.

If you're a fit, your profile goes straight to Blockit's hiring team, and only after you approve.

Comfort with experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases) and reproducibility hygiene

Happy working 5 days a week in-person with a small, high-intensity team

new_jobs.title: AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Thesis, we believe everyone should have the opportunity to meet their potential. We build nootropic supplements and customer experiences that help people find the right support for their goals.

Across Thesis and Stasis, we're also changing how our company works. Our teams use AI to develop creative, research customers, build digital experiences, analyze performance, and reduce repetitive operational work. We're looking for an engineer who can turn those experiments into reliable systems that people use every day.

About The Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to build the agents, integrations, and internal tools that help a small team accomplish more. You'll work with Data, Engineering, Growth, Creative, and Operations to find valuable problems, prototype solutions, and own them through deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on applied AI. You'll build with existing models, connect them to our tools and knowledge, and make their outputs useful and trustworthy. You should be as comfortable debugging an API integration as designing an agent workflow, and care about whether your work saves time, improves decisions, or helps the business grow.

We already have AI-assisted workflows and a shared Claude skill and knowledge system. You'll build on that foundation, making successful workflows easier to reuse and bringing production engineering to the parts that need it. You won't be starting from a blank page, and you won't be limited to maintaining what's already there.

How You'll Make an Impact

Build agents that do useful work

Design and ship agents that retrieve information, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks across our business systems.
Connect workflows across tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Asana, Shopify, and Klaviyo through APIs, webhooks, and MCP integrations.
Make long-running workflows dependable with persistent state, retries, duplicate prevention, clear approvals, and recoverable failures.

Accelerate creative and growth workflows

Partner with Creative and Growth to improve the path from customer research and performance insights to briefs, scripts, creative variants, and testable landing pages.
Build workflows that combine brand knowledge, approved product claims, asset libraries, and creative performance data while keeping human review where it matters.
Help teams learn from prior experiments so each new brief or test benefits from what we've already discovered.

Make company knowledge and data more useful

Extend our shared skills, knowledge base, retrieval, and context-management systems so AI tools can find and use the right source material.
Partner with our data team to connect AI workflows to governed analytics in Metabase and Hex, backed by Snowflake, rather than inventing competing definitions of business metrics.
Use SQL and data validation to investigate issues, verify outputs, and make analytical workflows easier for non-technical teammates to use.

Turn prototypes into reliable products

Build evaluations using real business tasks. Test accuracy, task completion, tool behavior, failure recovery, latency, and cost before scaling a workflow.
Add monitoring, useful logs, version control, automated tests, and clear documentation. Own failures after launch and fix their causes.
Protect customer and company data, separate brand and account contexts, and preserve human approval for consequential actions.
Choose the simplest approach that works, including ordinary code or deterministic automation when an LLM adds no value.

Help the company use AI well

Work directly with teammates to understand their workflows, ship usable interfaces, and help them adopt what you build.
Create reusable skills and integrations rather than isolated prompts that only their author can operate.
Evaluate new models and tools through practical experiments, then explain what is worth adopting and why.
Measure outcomes such as time saved, adoption, output quality, and faster experiment cycles, not just the number of automations shipped.

We're Excited About Your

Experience shipping software that real users depend on, with ownership beyond the initial prototype.
Hands-on LLM application development using Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable APIs, including structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, and multi-step workflows.
Strong Python or TypeScript skills, sound software design, and comfort working with APIs, authentication, databases, and asynchronous jobs.
Practical understanding of RAG, context management, and MCP. You can explain the tradeoffs and show when a simpler approach is better.
Ability to build evaluations, diagnose unreliable behavior, and improve an AI system using evidence rather than prompt tweaking alone.
Working SQL proficiency and experience validating data against established reporting or warehouse models.
Product judgment and clear communication. You can turn an ambiguous request into a focused solution, explain technical tradeoffs, and work effectively with non-technical partners.
Curiosity, initiative, and follow-through. You experiment independently, learn quickly, and take responsibility for whether your work is useful.

Experience with Claude Code, Codex, shared agent skills, or agent orchestration platforms such as OpenClaw is a plus. So is experience with ecommerce, consumer subscriptions, creative production, multimodal generation, or analytics tools such as PostHog and Metabase. We don't expect you to have used every tool in our stack.

How You'll Work

You'll work on problems with visible business impact, from reducing manual reporting to making creative production and customer research more effective. You'll partner closely with the people doing the work, test with real inputs, and keep improving the system after it ships.

We value people who can move quickly without confusing a convincing demo with a dependable product. Bring strong engineering fundamentals, good judgment about where AI helps, and a willingness to get into the details.

In Your Application

Tell us about an AI system you built that people actually use. What problem did it solve, what did you personally build, how did you evaluate it, and what failed along the way? Share a demo, repository, or architecture walkthrough where possible. Please don't include confidential information from another employer.

A Few of Our Perks and Benefits

Competitive compensation and equity.
Health, dental, and vision plans.
HSA, FSA, and pre-tax commuter benefits.
401k to help you plan for the future.
Flexible PTO.
Unlimited Thesis nootropics.
A strong emphasis on personal development and promoting from within.
A dog-friendly office in Flatiron, near Union Square and Madison Square Park.

Our Values

Meet Your Potential:
Keep learning, seek honest feedback, and help others grow.

Own Outcomes:
Take responsibility for results, act with urgency, and follow through.

Lead with Science and Data:
Seek the truth through evidence and use it to make better decisions.

Create Exceptional Experiences:
Show up for teammates and customers with care, high standards, and a sense of belonging.

Pay Transparency

Our salary ranges reflect competitive compensation for our size and industry and are one part of a total rewards package that includes benefits and equity. The base salary hiring range for this position is $160,000–$200,000. Final compensation will be based on the candidate's location, skill level, and experience.
